subject: Request: expert panel / customer spotlight for upcoming analyst note
messages:
From: Priya Nair <Priya.Nair@gartner.com>
To: alex_martinez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — customer spotlight for Infrastructure for Inference note

Hi Alex,

I'm working on an upcoming Gartner note about "Infrastructure for Inference" and would love to include a short customer spotlight on Cloudify's deployment with Redwood. Would Cloudify be willing to do a 30-minute reference call the week of Nov 30? We're aiming to capture:

- a high-level summary of the use case
- measurable outcomes (latency, cost, throughput improvements)
- a short quote (~1-2 sentences) we can publish

If possible, could you:
1) Confirm the right customer contact (preferably an engineering or product lead)
2) Share a draft case study or one-pager for review before the call
3) Let me know any legal/PR approvals we should route through in advance (NDA/PR embargo etc.)

Thanks — happy to be flexible on time.

Best,
Priya Nair
Senior Research Analyst — Cloud Platforms
Gartner

---
This is a research request; please let me know if there's an internal point of contact for approvals.
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Nair <Priya.Nair@gartner.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — customer spotlight for Infrastructure for Inference note

Hi Priya — thanks for the note and the invite. Happy to coordinate.

Quick answers up front:
- Customer contact: Emma Lopez, Head of ML Platform at Cloudify (cc'd) — she'll be the best person for the reference call.
- We can share a short draft case study and a metrics snapshot for review.
- For publication: Cloudify requires an approved reference release (DocuSign) and a 48-hour embargo window for quotes.

Proposed slots (PT) for a 30-minute call:
- Tue, Dec 1 — 10:00–10:30
- Wed, Dec 2 — 12:30–13:00
- Thu, Dec 3 — 08:30–09:00

Attaching our internal "Redwood reference guidelines" to speed approvals — Marissa, can you own the case draft and provide the 2 quote options for Cloudify to approve? Rishi, please confirm whether we need Legal to review the draft or if Marissa can handle with the PR checklist.

Priya, we'll also attach Gartner's questionnaire if you have one; Marissa will push that to the customer beforehand.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-reference-guidelines.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Priya Nair <Priya.Nair@gartner.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Emma Lopez <emma@cloudify.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 13:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — customer spotlight for Infrastructure for Inference note

Thanks Alex / Priya — looping in next steps from an advocacy standpoint.

Marissa's plan:
1) I'll send Cloudify a short intake (attached) with proposed talking points and the Gartner questionnaire filled with suggested answers to speed the call.
2) Provide 3 quote options: one technical (focus on latency/cost numbers), one product-focused (ease of integration), and one executive-friendly (business impact).
3) Share a draft case study (Doc in Drive) for Cloudify approval 48 hours before publish.

Please note: Cloudify will require a signed reference release before we publish any quotes. Alex, I've created a DocuSign envelope and included the Gartner team as the counterparty — link below. Emma, if you can sign that when you have a minute that would unblock us.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/3e8a1f-reference-release
Drive draft (internal): https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/Cloudify-case-draft-v2

Attaching the Gartner questionnaire template so Priya can confirm any extra fields: Gartner-questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)

Rishi: Legal review is only required if Cloudify requests changes to the release; otherwise I can shepherd approvals.

Alex — I can run the Dec 1, 10:00 PT slot if that works for Priya and Emma.

—
Marissa Cole
Customer Advocacy Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Gartner-questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Emma Lopez <emma@cloudify.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Nair <Priya.Nair@gartner.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — customer spotlight for Infrastructure for Inference note

Hi all — happy to participate and thanks for coordinating.

Dec 1 at 10:00 PT works for me. I'll prepare:
- a short set of success metrics (attached)
- a 1–2 sentence quote we are comfortable publishing

I've just signed the DocuSign reference release and attached a CSV export of the high-level metrics we discussed (latency p95 before/after, token cost delta, throughput uplift). If Priya needs any more detail ahead of the call, let me know and I can share a 1-page architecture diagram.

Looking forward —
Emma Lopez
Head of ML Platform, Cloudify Inc.
